name: PII Redact
description: Finds emails, phones, keys, IPs, names and places in a draft, on this Mac with no network, so they can be redacted before you send.

args:
(version 1)
(allow default)
(deny network*)
(deny process-exec)
(allow process-exec (literal "/bin/sh") (literal "/bin/bash") (literal "/bin/dash") (subpath "/opt/homebrew") (subpath "/usr/local") (regex #"^/Users/[^/]+/\.local/share/pii-redact/venv/bin/"))
(deny file-read* (subpath "/Users") (subpath "/Volumes"))
(allow file-read-metadata (literal "/Users") (regex #"^/Users/[^/]+(/\.local(/share(/pii-redact)?)?)?$"))
(allow file-read* (regex #"^/Users/[^/]+/\.local/share/pii-redact/venv(/|$)"))
(deny file-write*)
(allow file-write* (literal "/dev/null") (subpath "/private/var/folders"))
